scope: One successful-source current static output, exact15 generated page/alias visible-copy hashes, reviewed builder-only font asset copy-list delta, unchanged historical baseline and no legal/publication/design/hosted approval.

commands.name: visible-content
command: require './scripts/qa/public_content_contract'; require './scripts/qa/public_static_routes'; dir=ARGV.fetch(0); expected=JSON.parse(File.read('docs/release/public-website-current-content-contract.json')).fetch('hashes'); catalog=PublicStaticRoutes.extract(File.read(PublicStaticRoutes::SOURCE)); declared=catalog.select { |r| [:page,:alias].include?(r[:kind].to_sym) }.map { |r| r[:path] }.sort; actual_routes=Dir.glob(File.join(dir,'**','*.html')).map { |p| p.delete_prefix(dir).delete_suffix('index.html') }.reject { |r| ['/app/','/c/','/group-link/'].include?(r) }.sort; rows=actual_routes.map do |route| path=File.join(dir,route.delete_prefix('/'),'index.html'); bytes=File.binread(path); visible=PublicContentContract.visible_text(bytes.force_encoding('UTF-8')); digest=Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(visible); {route:route,html_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest,visible_text_sha256:digest,expected_sha256:expected[route],matches_reviewed_copy:digest==expected[route]} end; result={status:actual_routes==expected.keys.sort&&declared==actual_routes&&rows.all? { |r| r[:matches_reviewed_copy] } ? 'pass':'fail',generated_routes:actual_routes,declared_page_alias_routes:declared,rows:rows,legal_release_approved:false,publication_approved:false}; puts JSON.pretty_generate(result); exit(result[:status]=='pass' ? 0:1)
